description:
Pastor James Rafferty and Darrell Thomas answer key Bible questions about prophecy, salvation, and Scripture. Viewers ask: Will only the 144,000 preach the gospel? Do we truly go to Heaven when we die, or rest in peace? Plus insights on Matthew 24, Luke 17, 1 Kings 19, 1 Corinthians 15, Acts 15, and Zechariah 14.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org


The 144,000 are said to come from the house of God. Those who remain in the house of God, yet refuse to reform, are described as being slain by the slaughtering angel. If this is so, will only the 144,000 be left to go out and preach the gospel and gather the great multitude? Will only the 144,000 be left to preach the gospel?
John 3:13 says: no one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven, the Son of Man. Can you explain what Jesus meant when he said no one had gone to Heaven? What about Moses, Elijah, and Enoch?  What did Jesus mean in John 3:13?
Do we really go to Heaven after we die, or do we rest in peace? 
If only eight people were saved in the ark, how did we get all the different races in the world? 
What does "faith without works is dead" mean? Does it mean that as a Christian, if I'm not doing God's work, for example, missionary work, etc., my soul will be lost? 
Can you explain Matthew 24:40-41 and Luke 17:34-35, which state one taken and one left behind? 
I was speaking to someone about natural disasters and how they have been occurring more frequently and with more intensity. The person stated that they recently saw videos talking about how a lot of the natural disasters nowadays are man-made. They directed me to 1 Kings 19:11-13. Can you please explain this passage to me?  Can you please explain 1 Kings 19:11-13?
What is the meaning of 1 Corinthians 15:6? Is Paul saying that the majority of the 500 went to heaven and did not die an earthly death? 
Acts 15 states that New Testament Christians are not to eat things strangled or blood. Why aren't we all vegetarians or at least kosher, so we are not eating the blood of animals?  Can you please dive into Acts 15:20 & 29?
Can you explain Zechariah 14:4 in relation to Jesus's second coming?
